# A09-S107: Digital literacy

Extract from the operator’s source text. Transport metadata, signatures and marked context omitted.

[…]

The project will definitely be able to work really well in terms of involving young people in new reflections on democracy and publicity. I can see that you have a focus on early literacy, and this can certainly be used to teach digital literacy in a very concrete way.

The culture package is also a good match. You already have Sister’s Hope Home, and we could in that way supplement the artistic introduction to ‘feelings’ with one to ‘intelligence’. You clearly have several good offers for the youth, where I could create some hands-on exercises and performances in acting in a new culture that is no longer just for humans.

[…]
